text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to respond to Toronto and East York Community Council's direction to review and report back on the realignment of Permit Parking Area 8B to exclude the development located at 17 Boothroyd Avenue. The exclusion of the development located at 17 Boothroyd Avenue is a means to ensure that current permit holders have sufficient parking space. The issuance of parking permits to residents, guests, tradespeople, and caregivers of this development would negatively impact on the already limited parking supply in the neighbourhood. Staff have determined the realignment of the Permit Parking Area 8B is feasible and has no objections to excluding the development at 17 Boothroyd Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the amendment to Schedule B of the City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to incorporate a revised map of Permit Parking Area "8B", as shown in Attachment 1 of the report (June 4, 2021) from the Director, Permits and Enforcement, Transportation Services.
